            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()

        return user, session_id
